title: Have you ever met a famous person?

scene.speaker: diego
scene.bubble: Today's big question for the whole school: have you ever met a famous person? You won't believe the answers!

activities.title: Match the verb with its past participle.

items.sentence: Have you ___ flown in a helicopter?
I have ___ swum in the ocean — I'm afraid of waves!
She has ___ won a gold medal. She's amazing!
We have ___ been to Australia, but we want to go.

activities.title: Listen to Diego's street interviews. Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Diego: Ingrid! Have you ever met a famous person? … Ingrid: Yes! I met a famous swimmer at the pool. She signed my swimming cap! … Diego: Cool! Our cook says he has never met anyone famous… … Diego: …but he has cooked dinner for two hundred people at once! … Diego: The music teacher has flown in a hot air balloon over the mountains. … Diego: And the school cat? It has slept in every classroom of the school. Every single one! … Diego: Me? I've never met anyone famous… but after this report, maybe I'll BE famous!

activities.title: Exam task · Choose the correct form.

items.sentence: Have you ever ___ a famous person?
I have never ___ in a helicopter.
She has ___ across the widest part of the lake.
"Have you ever won a prize?" — "Yes, I ___."
They have ___ ridden a camel. It was in Egypt.

data.text: Find something your partner has done that you have never done. Ask: "Have you ever…?" (ridden a horse, flown in a plane, won a medal…). Report the most surprising answer.

homework.prompt: Write 3 true sentences with I have… and 2 with I have never… Choose interesting ones!
